items.question: Has the team identified the laws and regulations with a direct effect on the financial statements, such as the Companies Act, tax, VAT, PAYE, NSSF, SHIF and the housing levy?
Has the team identified other laws that may matter to the business or its licences (sector regulators, county permits, data protection, anti-money-laundering)?
Has management been asked, in writing or in a recorded meeting, whether the entity complies and whether there are any known breaches, notices or penalties?
Have tax assessments, penalty notices and correspondence with KRA and other authorities been inspected?
Have statutory returns and payments been checked for the year, and any late or missing ones noted?
Where a breach or suspected breach was found, has its effect on the financial statements and on the audit report been assessed?
Has the team considered whether a breach needs to be reported to a regulator or to those charged with governance?
